name: Crab, Muck
body:
Muck Crab
CR ½

XP 200
N Small vermin
Init +1; Senses darkvision 60 ft., Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 12, flat-footed 16 (+1 Dex, +5 natural, +1 size)
hp 5 (1d8+1)
Fort +3, Ref +1, Will +0
Immune mind-affecting effects

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee 2 claws +1 (1d3+1 plus grab)
Special Attacks constrict (1d3+1)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

STR 12, Dex 12, Con 12, Int -, Wis 10, Cha 1
Base Attack +0; CMB +0 (+4 grapple), CMD 11 (23 vs. trip)
Skills Stealth +2 (+6 in muddy or swampy terrain), Swim +8; Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth in muddy or swampy terrain
SQ amphibious

ECOLOGY

Environment edges of lakes and rivers, swamps
Organization solitary or caste (2 – 12)
Treasure none

This ugly crab blends in well with the muddy riverbank.

The muck crab is an ugly creature whose shell mimics the sliminess and coloration of mud and muck. They hunt primarily by waiting mired in mud for prey to approach. The only advantage a muck crab would have over another crab is its ability to live outside of water.
